finding.claim: Unauthenticated insecure deserialization: POST /restore passes a user-supplied base64 param directly to Marshal.load, allowing arbitrary object instantiation and gadget-chain remote code execution.

trace.note: route POST /restore, no auth filter or before block
params[:state] base64-decoded and passed to Marshal.load
result inspected and returned (inspect may also invoke gadget methods)

finding.guards_checked: No authentication, no signature/HMAC on the payload, no class allowlist, no rescue. Only one file in the repo; no middleware or before filters. The /import route uses JSON.parse, which is safe by default, and /health is constant.

verdict.reason: app.rb:5-6 shows the unauthenticated Sinatra POST /restore passing params[:state] through Base64.decode64 straight into Marshal.load, with no auth, signature, allowlist or rescue, and app.rb is the only file in the repo.
